note: Lifecycle rules (Operational Activities Instruction 2.13). 'rules': a CI sits in a status for more than 'days' days, counted from the day the record was created or last changed, to the date of the report. 'days' is the value proposed; the team sets its own number in Settings ('setting'). 'fix': the line of the fix list when SACM changes the status itself (Business Capabilities in Ready). 'review': the sample of the lifecycle review, drawn only from the classes EPO holds (Business Service, Service Offering, Service Instance), so every CI of the sample can be compared with EPO; drawn once on a button press and saved in data/reviews/ of the team folder.

rules.say: Status {status}, and the record did not change since {date} ({age} days)
Status {status} since it was created on {date} ({age} days)

processStages.note: The stages of a Business Process in Ready (D197). Waits for the BIA: no CIA value (Target) yet, no line, only a note. To map: CIA values and nothing live linked below of the classes in below: no line here, the process is a case of the Mapping backlog (D200), and a note says how many. Mapped: CIA values and something linked below: SACM makes it Operational.

waits.one: 1 Business Process in Ready waits for the BIA (no CIA values yet): nothing to do.
waits.many: {n} Business Processes in Ready wait for the BIA (no CIA values yet): nothing to do.

toMap.one: 1 Business Process in Ready is to map (CIA values set, nothing linked below): it is on the Mapping backlog.
toMap.many: {n} Business Processes in Ready are to map (CIA values set, nothing linked below): they are on the Mapping backlog.

mapped.say: Mapped: the CIA values are set and {below} linked below. Make it Operational
